title: Best Apple, Samsung and Sony Accessories to Buy in the UK (2026)
content_html:
Branded accessories can be expensive when bought new, but refurbished, open-box and used options can offer much better value. This guide covers the Apple, Samsung and Sony accessories we would check first if you want to save money without buying random unbranded alternatives.

The links below go to current eBay UK searches so you can compare live prices, condition, seller feedback and included accessories.

Some links in this article are affiliate links.

Apple AirPods - best-known Apple accessory

AirPods remain one of the most popular accessories for iPhone users. Because there are many generations and variants, check the exact model carefully before buying and pay attention to charging-case type and condition.

Best for: iPhone users who want seamless pairing and Apple's ecosystem features.

Check current AirPods listings on eBay UK

Apple Watch - best companion for iPhone

A refurbished Apple Watch can be much cheaper than buying new. Look at case size, GPS or cellular version, battery information and whether a charger and strap are included.

Best for: fitness tracking, notifications and everyday iPhone integration.

Check current refurbished Apple Watch listings on eBay UK

Samsung Galaxy Buds - best Samsung audio accessory

Galaxy Buds are a natural choice for Samsung phone owners and can offer strong value on the refurbished market. Make sure the charging case is included and confirm the exact Buds generation.

Best for: Samsung Galaxy phone users who want easy ecosystem integration.

Check current Galaxy Buds listings on eBay UK

Samsung Galaxy Watch - best Android smartwatch pairing

Galaxy Watch models are a strong option if you use Android, particularly a Samsung handset. Refurbished pricing can make older premium models more attractive than a brand-new budget smartwatch.

Best for: Android users wanting fitness features, notifications and Samsung integration.

Check current refurbished Galaxy Watch listings on eBay UK

Sony DualSense controller - best PS5 accessory

A spare DualSense controller is one of the most useful PS5 accessories. Used and refurbished examples can save money, but controller wear matters, so check seller notes for stick drift, trigger faults and battery issues.

Best for: local multiplayer, replacing a worn controller or keeping a charged spare.

Check current DualSense listings on eBay UK

Sony headphones - best premium audio option

Sony's over-ear headphones are frequently available refurbished and can be a good way to get premium noise-cancelling features for less. Check the exact model number, ear-pad condition and included case or cables.

Best for: commuting, travel and buyers who want premium wireless audio.

Check current refurbished Sony headphone listings on eBay UK

Are branded accessories worth paying more for?

Often, yes, when the accessory relies on ecosystem features. Apple Watch, AirPods, Galaxy Watch and DualSense controllers all offer integration or functionality that cheap generic alternatives may not fully reproduce.

What should you check before buying?

Check authenticity, exact model number, compatibility, included cables or cases, battery information where relevant, cosmetic condition, seller feedback, warranty and returns. Be especially cautious with very cheap branded accessories if the listing is vague about authenticity.

Our pick

The best buy depends on the device you already own. AirPods and Apple Watch make the most sense for iPhone users, Galaxy Buds and Galaxy Watch for Samsung users, and a DualSense controller is one of the most useful PS5 extras.

Guide updated September 2026. Prices, promotions, stock and condition change regularly, so always check the live listing before purchasing.
